title: ‘I’m going for a few pints now’: nerves and joy as students collect their A-level results

paragraphs.en: There are few days that teenagers dread more than A-level results day , where students learn how the last two years of their lives will shape their futures, communicated through a few letters in an envelope.
paragraphs.zh: 很少有哪一天比 A-level 放榜日更让青少年焦虑的了——在这一天，学生们通过信封里的几个字母，得知过去两年的生活将如何塑造自己的未来。

paragraphs.en: The tension of walking into college to learn your fate is enough to keep most people awake the night before. For Hayden Bettson-Day, 18, the best solution was get it over with as early as possible.
paragraphs.zh: 走进学校得知自己命运的那种紧张感，足以让大多数人在前一晚失眠。对 18 岁的海登·贝特森-戴（Hayden Bettson-Day）来说，最好的解决办法就是尽可能早地了结此事。

paragraphs.en: “I was refreshing the Ucas page at 8 o’clock in the morning, waiting for it to go on,” Hayden said. “So, it was a definite bit of tension. My mum kept asking: ‘What is it? What did you get?”
paragraphs.zh: “我早上 8 点就一直在刷新 Ucas 页面，等着成绩上线，”海登说。“所以当时确实有点紧张。我妈一直问：‘什么成绩？你考得怎么样？’”

paragraphs.en: What Hayden got was an A* in maths coupled with two As in chemistry and biology, which is enough to be accepted into Newcastle University to study medicine.
paragraphs.zh: 海登考出的成绩是数学 A*，外加化学和生物两个 A，这足以让他被纽卡斯尔大学（Newcastle University）录取攻读医学。

paragraphs.en: The 18-year-old is one of 450 students at Trinity sixth form academy, located in the town’s centre and part of the Trinity multi-academy trust, which has colleges throughout Yorkshire.
paragraphs.zh: 这位 18 岁的年轻人是位于镇中心的圣三一六年级学院（Trinity sixth form academy）的 450 名学生之一。该学院属于圣三一多学院信托机构（Trinity multi-academy trust），后者在约克郡各地都设有学院。

paragraphs.en: Aidan Chiu and Fran Whitehead, two of Hayden’s classmates, spoke about their own relief at their results, having both received A*s in chemistry.
paragraphs.zh: 海登的两名同学艾丹·邱（Aidan Chiu）和弗兰·怀特黑德（Fran Whitehead）谈到了拿到成绩后的如释重负，两人都拿到了化学 A*。

paragraphs.en: “My mum’s on the phone to Bristol University,” said Aidan, who plans to study maths. “I have the grades I need, but she’s still calling them to make sure I got in. I can’t believe it.”
paragraphs.zh: “我妈妈正在给布里斯托大学（Bristol University）打电话，”打算学习数学的艾丹说。“我的成绩已经达到要求，但她还是打电话确认我是否被录取了。我简直不敢相信。”

paragraphs.en: Fran, who will now study geology at the University of Exeter, said that the last two years had been difficult, but praised the college for helping her settle and supporting her as she readjusted to a new environment during such a pivotal time in her life.
paragraphs.zh: 弗兰将前往埃克塞特大学（University of Exeter）学习地质学。她说，过去两年很艰难，但她称赞学校帮助她安顿下来，并在她人生如此关键的时期重新适应新环境时给予了她支持。
